title: Intern QA Engineer
text:
Ryanair Labs are currently recruiting for an Intern QA Engineer to join Europe’s Largest Airline Group!

This is a very exciting time to join Ryanair as we look to expand our operation to 800 aircraft and 300 million guests within the next 10 years.

Ryanair Labs is the technology brand of Ryanair. Labs is a state of-the-art digital & IT innovation hub creating Europe’s Leading Travel Experience for our customers.

We are launching a 3 month full-time paid IT Internship Program which will give you the opportunity to work within the Ryanair Labs Teams. After successful completion there will be a possibility of extending the cooperation on fixed-term civil contract / contract of employment and then prospect of staying with us long term!

We are looking for people available to attend our office for 40 hours per week – 8 hours daily from Monday to Friday (regular business hours starting between 8:00–9:30).

We are seeking individuals who have a story to tell and who have strong outside interests. Cultural fit at Ryanair is just as important as academics.

We are currently looking for talents in the field of Manual Software Testing. You will be paired up with our Senior QA Engineers who help your career take off! You will be working across our web or mobile projects, internal and dedicated to our customers.

The Role



- Learn and apply QA methodologies, tools, and testing frameworks.
- Partner up with the QA team in verifying software quality through manual testing activities.
- Execute test cases and accurately report defects, errors, or unexpected results.
- Assist in creating, maintaining, or updating test documentation.
- Collaborate with agile team members: testers, developers, product owners, and other stakeholders.
- Attend Agile (Scrum or Kanban) meetings – contribute as appropriate.
- Student / absolvent in a field of Computer Science or any IT background
- Good command of English (min. B2)
- Basic knowledge of manual software testing
- Hands-on experience with leading QA technologies.
- Mentorship and guidance from experienced professionals.
- Opportunity to work on meaningful projects that impact the organization.
- A collaborative and inclusive work environment.
- Potential for future career opportunities within the company.

Recruitment process



- Application form – send us your application in English plus short introduction of yourself, and why you want to join the IT Internship Program.
- Short test – we will send you a quick test to check your technical skills, but also creative thinking, time management and reading comprehension.
- Phone call – short conversation with Recruiter when we will share with you all the details about work and we will speak about your expectations and future. Also we will check your English level.
- Interview – technical interview with the Team and then Team Manager.
- Offer – if we’re a match, we’ll present you with an offer and schedule your start day with us!

During each of above steps we’ll be happy to answer any questions you may have. Apply today to discuss the role in more detail!

title: Manual QA Engineer (Embedded & Python)
text:

- Prepare and execute manual test cases for embedded and connected healthcare solutions. 
- Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing. 
- Verify new features and changes against defined requirements and acceptance criteria. 
- Test interactions between embedded devices, applications, and other system components. 
- Identify, reproduce, and clearly document software defects. 
- Analyse test results and basic technical logs to support issue investigation. 
- Create and maintain test documentation, including test cases and test reports. 
- Work closely with developers and other QA team members to investigate issues and verify fixes. 
- Support the team in maintaining good test coverage and continuously improving testing processes. 
- Use Python when needed to support testing activities, analyse data, or perform simple testing-related tasks.

Our client is a technology company specialising in digital healthcare solutions and connected medical devices. Their products support areas such as remote patient monitoring, medication management, and patient engagement.

Qualifications



- 3-4 years of commercial experience in software testing / quality assurance. 
- Practical experience with manual software testing, including functional and regression testing. 
- Previous experience testing embedded systems, connected devices, or IoT solutions. 
- Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python and willingness to use it in day-to-day testing activities. 
- Good understanding of software testing principles and test case design. 
- Experience reporting and tracking defects using tools such as JIRA or similar platforms.

- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki - Wrocław, Bielany Wrocławskie 2027
text:
Description

Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.

Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:

Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin

Key job responsibilities

Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.

Kluczowe Obowiązki Stanowiska



-  Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników
-  Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy
-  Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych
-  Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.
-  Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.
-  Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.
-  Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.
-  Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.

A day in the life

Dzień z życia stażysty

Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.

About The Team

O zespole

Społeczność Stażystów



-  Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowan

title: Quant Modeling Specialist - Intern
text:
Job Type

Temporary / Contract

Job Reference #

345022BR

City

Kraków, Wroclaw

Key Responsibilities

Are you interested in applying data science, statistics and econometrics to real-world problems in global finance? Do you enjoy working with data, building models and understanding what drives financial performance?

We are looking for a Quantitative Analyst Intern to join our PPNR Stress Testing team. You will work alongside experienced quantitative analysts and gain hands-on experience in developing and applying models used to understand how financial businesses may perform under different economic scenarios.

In this role, you will:



-  Develop and enhance quantitative projection models using time-series data, regression techniques and other statistical and econometric approaches.
-  Work with large financial and economic datasets, using Python to explore data, identify relationships and translate analytical findings into modelling solutions.
-  Build and improve analytical tools supporting model testing, diagnostics, performance monitoring and efficient model execution.
-  Support model calibration, testing and implementation, gaining practical experience with the end-to-end model development lifecycle.
-  Contribute to high-quality model documentation, clearly explaining methodology, assumptions, limitations and analytical results.
-  Gain exposure to model validation and governance, supporting models as they progress through independent review and approval processes.
-  Collaborate with quantitative analysts, business experts and other stakeholders on model development, implementation and review.
-  Support quarterly model execution and analysis, helping the team understand and explain model results under baseline and hypothetical stress scenarios.
-  Prepare clear analyses and presentations that communicate quantitative results to both technical and non-technical audiences.

The team

Banking regulators around the world require systemically important financial institutions to demonstrate their ability to withstand adverse economic conditions through processes commonly referred to as stress testing. This makes quantitative modelling an important part of risk and capital management.

You will join our PPNR Stress Testing team, where we develop and maintain mathematical and econometric models that project financial performance under baseline and hypothetical stress scenarios over a multi-year horizon.

Our work sits at the intersection of data science, econometrics, finance and risk management. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to see how quantitative techniques learned at university are applied to real financial data and business problems, while developing practical modelling, programming and communication skills.

Your Skills And Experience

We are looking for a student or recent graduate with a strong quantitative mindset and genuine interest in applying analytical methods to finance.

You will ideally have:



-  Current or recently completed studies in a quantitative field such as data science, statistics, econometrics, economics, finance, mathematics, computer science, physics, engineering, or a related discipline.
-  A good foundation in statistics, regression analysis and/or time-series analysis. Familiarity with methods such as ARDL, ECM, ARIMA, VAR or GLM is an advantage, but we do not expect you to be an expert in all of them.
-  Practical experience with Python for data analysis, statistical modelling or machine learning, whether gained through university coursework, research, internships or personal projects.
-  Curiosity about financial markets, banking, economics and risk management. Previous professional experience in finance is not required.
-  The ability to approach problems analytically, work with data and explain your conclusions clearly.

title: Young Talent in Data and Software Engineering (Kraków or Wroclaw, Poland)
text:
Who We Are
Founded in 2017, Unit8 is a fast-growing Swiss AI and data analytics consulting and services company dedicated to solving complex problems of traditional industries like automotive, chemical, financial services, manufacturing and pharma. We work with some of the biggest organizations in Europe to solve the challenges that directly affect their business - be it operations, finance, manufacturing or R&D. Since our foundation, we have successfully delivered more than 300 projects and have grown to 190+ talented individuals across 10 office locations.


Unit8's mission is to drive the adoption of AI and Data Science in the non-digital industries and to help accelerate their digital transformation. Among its activities, Unit8 dedicates a part of its resources and time on projects that deeply matter to us - that includes collaboration on pro-bono and "engineering for good" causes.


What You'll Do
Unit8 is welcoming young talents for the opportunity to grow in Data and Software Engineering. Join us for a 6-month paid professional experience in building industrial Data and AI solutions. You can start asap, with direct exposure to clients' needs and opportunities to participate in learning activities such as Reading Groups and Knowledge Sharing Sessions. In addition, each young talent will be accompanied by a dedicated wingmate/mentor who will guide and help them build their technical growth vision.


As a young talent, you will join a team of Data & AI Engineers, Data Engineers, and Cloud Engineers who work hand-in-hand with our customers on designing and implementing their industry-specific use cases. You will be directly involved in discussing the client's challenges and needs and will have chances to develop your client-facing skills. You will be responsible for developing, deploying, and automating our AI services and cloud infrastructure. You will also learn to carefully analyze a given problem and apply the relevant tools and techniques to solve it.


In general you will:

- use software best practices in continuous integration and delivery, versioning and automation;
- use your skills to build and maintain service and data infrastructure;
- participate as junior engineer in all phases of the software development life cycle - planning, implementation, deployment, testing and maintenance;


Are You the team member we are looking for?
In order to be successful in this role, you are/have:

- motivated and eager to learn different aspects of engineering
- comfortable interacting with technical and business people
- strong communication and presentation skills
- recently graduated/finishing your MSc or BSc in Computer Science or related major;
- familiar with version control and collaboration tooling (git)
- familiar with CI/CD frameworks and automated deployment concepts (i.e Docker, K8s)
- fluent in English

What We Offer

- Exposure to a wide variety of projects, industries, and technologies. Each client is different and provides unique opportunities to learn.
- Ability to contribute to internal open-source projects like Darts
- Learning activities such as ML Reading Group, knowledge sharing sessions with engineers
- Training-on-the-job and your personal wingmate/mentor
- 15 paid days off
- Be part of an international team of more than 30 nationalities
- Up to 10% of paid time for self-development
- Flexible working hours, including some home office
- Cross offices/company-wide frequent events like offsites
- If you are successful, opportunity to be hired for a permanent position

A Snapshot of Your Day

In our HVDC Protection Team, we are testing and verifying the hardware and software for our innovative HVDC Projects in our Test Center and ensure proper functionality and good quality of our HVDC Plants worldwide during commissioning. Our diverse and multinational teams are working closely together with project management, engineering as well as with end customers to provide customized solutions based on the latest innovations in HVDC technology.

How You’ll Make An Impact



- You actively advance the Energy Transition by bringing our HVDC projects to a successful completion with our customers
- You are part of a project team in Integration Testing and you carry out Functional Tests of the Control & Protection hardware and software in one of our test centers
- You independently trace bugs and support our Software Engineering in debugging
- You are responsible for the execution and documentation of the Functional Performance Tests (FPT) and Dynamic Performance Tests (DPT) of the HVDC System, including Customer Acceptance Tests in one of our test centers
- You are responsible for the commissioning of the Measuring System, the DC Protection System and the Transient Fault Recorder for our HVDC Projects as a part of a highly motivated team, at our customers sites worldwide 
- You support our Commissioning Management in Quality, Risk and Claim Management and you actively participate in our improvement programs


What You Bring



- Completed degree in electrical engineering, energy technology or comparable education / qualification
- Good knowledge in one or more of the following areas: project planning and testing via MATLAB/SIMULINK, Siemens SIMATIC TDC/S7, CFC, grid protection systems
- Knowledge or ideally working experience in the field of Electrical Engineering and Commissioning of Electrical Power Stations or HVDC Systems 
- Expertise in Current- and Voltage Measuring devices and other primary equipment 
- Fluent English language skills, additional languages are a plus
- Willingness for worldwide business trips and mainly long-term assignments on construction sites in Germany and abroad, as well as optional assignments on offshore platforms 


Your opportunities for personal growth: development as Commissioning Manager, Technical Expert or in Project Management

About The Team

Our Grid Technologies division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world’s electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion, and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character—no matter what ethnic background,

title: QA Software Engineering Expert
text:
Jako tester w naszym zespole transformacyjnym stawisz czoła wyzwaniu nowej generacji: weryfikacji systemów, w których kod współtworzony jest przez agentic AI. Twoim głównym celem będzie dbanie o to, by nowoczesne aplikacje CRM/ERP były nie tylko w pełni funkcjonalne, ale wolne od błędów. W modelu zwinnych, 2-3 osobowych zespołów (taxi-teams) staniesz się kluczowym ogniwem łączącym wizję analityka biznesowego z wygenerowaną rzeczywistością kodu. To rola dla eksperta, który chce redefiniować standardy QA w erze AI.

Profil stanowiska



- Posiadasz min. 5 letnie doświadczenie w testowaniu złożonych aplikacji biznesowych (mile widziane systemy klasy ERP/CRM).
- Posiadasz zaawansowane umiejętności w zakresie tworzenia testów automatycznych (E2E, API).
- Znasz i potrafisz efektywnie wykorzystywać narzędzia do testowania wydajnościowego, co jest kluczowe przy dużej liczbie użytkowników systemów ERP.
- Cechujesz się wybitnie krytycznym myśleniem - potrafisz bezbłędnie "złapać" anomalie i błędy logiczne, które AI mogło ukryć pod pozorem poprawnie wyglądającego kodu.

Twoje zadania



- Automatyzacja testów wspomagana przez AI: Efektywne wykorzystanie narzędzi AI do błyskawicznego generowania zaawansowanych scenariuszy testowych oraz skryptów (np. Playwright, Cypress).
- Weryfikacja zgodności z systemami ERP/CRM: Skrupulatne sprawdzanie, czy nowo powstająca aplikacja webowa zwraca identyczne i poprawne wyniki biznesowe co system źródłowy oparty na kodzie legacy.
- Testy regresji i integracji: Zapewnienie najwyższej stabilności całego ekosystemu w warunkach dynamicznego tempa dostarczania nowych funkcji przez zespoły typu taxi-teams.
- Audyt UX/UI: Bliska współpraca z Product Designerem w celu weryfikacji, czy frontend wygenerowany przez AI jest w 100% zgodny z przyjętym Design Systemem.

Dla Ciebie



- Prywatna opieka medyczna w Allianz - dostęp do specjalistów i badań diagnostycznych dla Ciebie i Twoich najbliższych.
- System kafeteryjny - możesz wybrać pełne dofinansowanie do karty Multisport czy przeznaczyć środki na kulturę, wypoczynek lub sport i zakupy.
- Możliwość pracy w modelu hybrydowym po okresie wdrożenia (2 dni pracy zdalnej, 3 dni pracy z biura).
- Możliwość korzystania z zaawansowanych narzędzi AI i Google Workspace.
- Współpraca z różnymi zespołami kompetencyjnymi, która pozwoli Ci na poznanie nowych technologii i poszerzenie wiedzy w obszarze IT.
- Profesjonalny rozwój zawodowy, realny wpływ na podejmowane decyzje biznesowe.
- Udogodnienia dla rowerzystów/ rowerzystek (stojaki, szatnie, rowerownie, stacja naprawcza), a dla tych, co do pracy docierają samochodem – naziemny i podziemny parking.

title: Embedded QA Engineer (Connectivity)
text:
Team Summary

Our team specializes in testing complex embedded systems for high-performance video capture, streaming, and CV/AI-driven processing. We support two key efforts: developing a next-generation, highly secure video camera product and sustaining our market-leading product line. We deliver comprehensive quality assessment across the entire stack — from embedded firmware and operating systems to networking and application software — with security and reliability at the core of everything we do.

Job Summary

We are looking for a QA Engineer with a strong technical background, hands-on experience testing embedded software, and solid knowledge of wired and wireless networking technologies. The ideal candidate is passionate about learning new technologies, continuously improving their skills, and sharing knowledge with others.

Responsibilities and Duties



- Perform requirements analysis for embedded device functionality in the connectivity domain.
- Design and maintain test coverage for new features and device functionality.
- Analyze and improve existing test coverage.
- Create and maintain test documentation, including test plans, test reports, and traceability matrices.
- Execute test cases according to established test plans.
- Report, track, and support defect resolution throughout the development lifecycle.
- Prepare and communicate test execution reports.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop new functionality and enhance existing features.
- Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Connectivity Lab and testing equipment, including Wi-Fi infrastructure, cellular base stations, and related hardware.

Qualifications And Skills



- 3+ years of experience in manual testing, with hands-on experience testing embedded systems.
- Knowledge of software testing methodologies and experience creating test documentation
- Experience in Linux/UNIX environments, including command-line tools and log analysis.
- Strong understanding of networking fundamentals, including the OSI model, wired and wireless networking technologies.
- Understanding of embedded systems principles
- Experience with bug tracking systems
- Ability to root-cause failures across software, firmware, and hardware
- Good communication skills and ability to collaborate across cross-functional teams
- Good written and spoken English
- Ability to work from our office in Wrocław.

Nice to have



- Experience testing networking or IoT devices
- Experience with cellular networking technologies (3G, LTE), GNSS, BLE, LoRa, LMR
- Network security knowledge (Firewalls, VPN, Wireless security, traffic encryption)
- Experience with audio/video data streaming
- Linux scripting with Bash, Zsh, and Python.

We offer multiple benefits that include



- The environment of equal opportunities, transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member
- Competitive salary packages with performance-based annual reviews
- Opportunity to receive a Performance Bonus for your individual achievements and a Loyalty Bonus recognizing your dedication to the company
- Employment via Contract of Employment (UoP) in complete alignment with Polish Labour Law
- Guaranteed paid vacation, public holidays, and medical leaves as per statutory regulations
- Continuous growth and development opportunities through internal knowledge hubs, corporate courses, and free English classes
- Comprehensive private medical insurance to supplement your standard NFZ coverage.

Our embedded software engineering team's mission is to craft reliable, high-performance solutions that reach millions of homes worldwide within the home security market. We follow agile development methodologies with regular sprint cycles, code reviews, and continuous integration practices. The team's established approach emphasizes comprehensive testing, rigorous security standards, and close collaboration with hardware engineering, product management, and customer support teams. We pride ourselves on writing clean, maintainable code and fostering a culture of knowledge sharing and technical excellence.

We're seeking a skilled C & C++ Embedded Engineer to take ownership of critical software components in our camera-based security devices. This role involves maintaining existing products through comprehensive debugging and bug fixing, as well as developing innovative new features.

Responsibilities and Duties



- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality embedded software in C and C++ for camera-based security devices.

Our embedded software engineering team's mission is to craft reliable, high-performance solutions that reach millions of homes worldwide within the home security market. We follow agile development methodologies with regular sprint cycles, code reviews, and continuous integration practices. The team's established approach emphasizes comprehensive testing, rigorous security standards, and close collaboration with hardware engineering, product management, and customer support teams. We're seeking a skilled C++ Embedded Engineer to take ownership of critical software components in our camera-based security devices. This role involves maintaining existing products through comprehensive debugging and bug fixing, as well as developing innovative new features.

Responsibilities and Duties



- Design, develop, and maintain high-quality embedded software in C++ for camera-based security devices.

- Solid understanding of network programming and experience with multithreading on multicore microcontrollers.
- Expertise in communication interfaces (I2C, SPI, UART, and Wi-Fi) and experience writing device drivers and libraries.
- Ability to work independently and take ownership of complex projects.
- Excellent communication skills for technical discussions and documentation, with a collaborative mindset for cross-functional team environments.

Nice to have



- Experience with Python for scripting and automation
- Experience with C in embedded development
- Understanding of security protocols and encryption methods
- Experience using AI-powered tools to enhance productivity and code quality

We offer multiple benefits that include



- The environment of equal opportunities, transparent and value-based corporate culture, and an individual approach to each team member

- Continuous growth and development opportunities through internal knowledge hubs, corporate courses, and free English classes

title: Open Source C / Rust Engineer
text:
In our team we develop Renode - an open source development framework for embedded systems that allows you to emulate complicated multi-node environments. We bring what's best in open source software development to the world of embedded, with testing capabilities, continuous integration and rapid prototyping.


As a team member you will work on emulation of various computer architectures, such as RISC-V, ARM or x86. You will be expected to learn the details of various open source operating systems, working on improving the Renode workflow and extending its capabilities. This portion of your job will involve research and exploratory works, pushing tech to the limits. You will be required to analyze the performance of and to create unit tests for your code. You will have to solve complex problems that might include working with assembly, code generation, code translation, interoperability between higher and lower level languages and portability between different OSes. This will require you to work with different codebases in C, Rust and other languages.

- Bachelor or Master degree in computer science, electronics or related fields

- experience and deep understanding of LLVM

title: Mechanical Engineer
text:
Team Summary

Our Mechanical Engineering team is responsible for driving innovation from the initial concept through to high-volume production for our key stakeholders' products. We serve as the vital integration hub, bridging the gap between various hardware disciplines, including Radio Frequency, Electrical Engineering, and Optics. Our lab is fully equipped with state-of-the-art tools for rapid prototyping, comprehensive testing, and advanced hardware development, offering a dynamic environment for hands-on engineering.

Job Summary

This role is designed for a self-guided Mechanical Engineer who enjoys driving mechanical innovation from the ground up. You will be responsible for navigating the most challenging aspects of the product development, from initial CAD modeling to design verification and field support. With an ownership mindset, you will guide mechanical components through iterative design cycles, managing everything from material selection to supplier coordination to ensure we deliver on quality, cost, and schedule.

Responsibilities And Duties



- Drive mechanical component development from initial concept to mass production, building high-fidelity CAD models, detailed drawings, and comprehensive BOMs
- Collaborate closely with Electrical, Firmware, and Optical engineers to ensure seamless cross-functional hardware integration and design performance
- Lead mechanical validation tests, such as fit, stress, and thermal analysis, and support design verification through iterative prototyping and lab testing

Cosma provides a comprehensive range of body, chassis and engineering solutions to global customers. Through our robust product engineering, outstanding tooling capabilities and diverse process expertise, we continue to bring lightweight and innovative products to market.

- Design and optimize die cast tooling, including runner systems, cooling circuits, vacuum systems, seals, and trim tools to achieve superior casting quality, productivity, and yield.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field.

- Experience with die design, runner systems, cooling system design, and vacuum technologies.
- Ability to assess manufacturing feasibility from engineering drawings and assemblies.
- Hands-on experience in process optimization and troubleshooting within a manufacturing environment.

title: Junior Pricing Specialist

This role is a good opportunity for someone who enjoys working with numbers and data, has a strong eye for detail and wants to develop practical experience in Pricing, Excel and SAP.
We are looking for potential, analytical skills and willingness to learn rather than extensive professional experience.
What matters most to us is your analytical mindset, accuracy, willingness to develop and ability to work systematically with data.


1.     Main Responsibilities & Tasks



- Performing daily pricing calculations and data analysis based on available business and purchasing data.
- Working extensively with Excel to analyze, compare and validate pricing information.
- Investigating pricing discrepancies and identifying the reasons behind them.
- Preparing and checking data before pricing updates are made.
- Implementing and maintaining pricing information in SAP.
- Verifying the accuracy and completeness of pricing data.
- Analyzing large amounts of information and identifying inconsistencies or areas requiring correction.
- Supporting the team with ad-hoc pricing analyses and data-related tasks.
- Cooperating with other teams to clarify pricing, cost and material-related information.
- Monitoring cost and price fluctuations and analyzing their impact on sales performance and profitability.

- Strong analytical and numerical skills.

- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Ability to identify discrepancies and investigate their root cause.
- Structured and systematic approach to work.

- Good command of English, both written and spoken.

- Previous experience with SAP.

We are open to candidates at the beginning of their professional career. Previous experience in Pricing is not a must if you have the right analytical mindset and are willing to learn.
As this is a junior-level position, you will receive comprehensive training in SAP and in our end-to-end pricing process. You will gradually learn how to analyse pricing data, perform pricing calculations, identify and resolve discrepancies, and maintain pricing information in SAP.
3.   Education & Experience

title: Field Engineer_Generator Diagnostics
text:
Job Description Summary

The Field Engineer - Generator diagnostics leads the on-site diagnostic activities. Generator inspections and diagnostics are carried out in close cooperation with the back office, the engineering team and the remote support team. The Field Engineer is also entrusted with electrical and mechanical diagnostic work on the generator as well as monitoring repair work on the generator. He will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to technically complex problems, and resolve problems through immediate action or short-term planning.

The Field Engineer is responsible for the generator diagnosis, which mainly consists of electrical tests, visual inspections and inspections carried out with robotic systems.

Further responsibilities of the field engineer include planning, organizing, integrating and managing tools and materials required to complete the scope of work in accordance with the contractual requirements. He will work within defined parameters to make decisions, apply concepts to issues of technical complexity, and resolve issues through immediate action or short-term planning. The field engineer implements and executes the work under safety, environmental and quality policies, serving as an example for others and provide full and active commitment in the deployment of the EHS and quality policies.

Job Description

Tasks and responsibilities



- Diagnostics on the generator such as visual inspections and electrical tests on stators, rotors and other electrical components
- Perform generator diagnostics, including visual inspections and electrical tests on stators, rotors, and other electrical components
- Perform robotic inspections and high voltage tests on generators
- Recommissioning of air-cooled and H2-cooled generators
- Troubleshooting of electrical systems
- Plan, organize, integrate and direct labor and tool and material allocation
- Provide technical expertise to customers, service support, field technicians and operators
- Support in planning diagnostic activities and carrying out diagnosis on site
- Ensure contractual obligations are met
- Attend technical meetings with customers as weel as provide timely and accurate internal and external reports
- Loop-check and adjustment of analogue, binary and other measurements
- Adjustment of instrumentation
- Perform other duties as assigned
- Drive customer satisfaction through commitment to quality
- Maintain strong safety mindset to assure the executed work reflects the technical requirements within GE safety standards

Required Qualifications



- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Power Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent qualifications gained through relevant practical experience
- Ideally understanding of electrical testing methods, candidates who are eager to learn and develop in this area are encouraged to apply
- Strong technical competence in reading and interpreting circuit diagrams and technical requirement specifications
- Ability and willingness to travel (nationally and internationally, around 80% might vary depending on status of projects), and to work holidays, weekends, and overtime as required by field assignments
- Fluency in English and Polish, both written and spoken

Desired Characteristics



- Knowledge and skill to actively support field service activities and be aware of where to seek answers to questions as they arise.
- Experience in a field service or generator diagnostics
- Analytic, organizational and problem-solving skills

What We Offer



- Employment under an employment contract in an international company with a strong position in the energy market
- Extensive personal and professional development opportunities in an innovative and future- oriented environment.
- Open and supportive corporate culture that promotes creativity and teamwork.
- Attractive compensation package including private medical care, life insurance, Multi-Sport card and annual bon

title: Quality Engineer
text:

What You Will Experience In This Position



- Represent the Quality function and serve as the primary liaison for customers, building strong relationships and confidence in our processes.
- Engage with customers at multiple organizational levels, proactively addressing concerns and aligning on quality expectations.
- Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across manufacturing, engineering, operations, and suppliers, both within and outside the organization.
- Support production teams in ensuring that high-quality, compliant products are consistently delivered in accordance with established processes.
- Lead and participate in defect reduction initiatives, ensuring timely disposition of nonconformities and implementation of corrective actions.
- Manage internal Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) and external quality issues, including customer complaints, from identification through resolution.
- Evaluate suspect or nonconforming materials, working with cross-functional teams to quickly diagnose issues and implement effective corrective actions.
- Lead quality problem-solving efforts methodologies, including containment actions, root cause analysis, and sustainable corrective actions.
- Support Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) activities for new product launches, including PFMEAs, Control Plans, GR&R studies, Capability Studies, and First Article Inspections (FAI).

You Have



- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics).
- Fluent Polish, English - B2
- Minimum of 5 years of experience in manufacturing or quality-related processes.
- Experience leading technical or production teams in a manufacturing or operational environment.
- Quality certifications such as APQP-PPAP, and ISO 9001:2015 Internal Auditor training are highly preferred.
- Experience in process improvement, planning, Six Sigma methodologies, Lean Manufacturing, and quality systems.

title: Backend / AI Developer - Freelancer
text:
About The Project

We're building an AI Transformation platform for an enterprise client, focused on back-office process automation and AI-driven decision support. The platform brings together data from multiple business systems and puts AI agents on top of it, so that business teams get actionable insights and automated workflows instead of manual routines.

Requirements

What You'll Do



- Integrate data from multiple business sources (CRM, analytics, BI) into a single, cohesive data layer
- Build and deploy AI agents that execute specific business tasks: signal analysis, pricing, content/SEO, data classification and tagging
- Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers: dedicated, read-only, domain-specific servers that expose data to agents and tools
- Do data engineering work: schema design, ETL and synchronization from external systems, and ensuring data quality and consistency
- Contribute to the agent platform architecture: routing layer, cost control, access policies, and telemetry for LLM calls
- Design and build backend APIs connecting the data layer with agents and front-end applications
- Create user-facing tools for business teams, driven by data and agent-generated insights
- Maintain infrastructure: containerization, database management, monitoring, and observability
- Document architectural decisions and keep strict contracts between system layers

Tech Stack

Python



-  FastAPI
-  Agno (agent framework)
-  MCP
-  PostgreSQL
-  Docker / Docker Compose
-  Next.js

What we are looking for:

title: Staż w dziale operacji i logistyki - Dobromierz 2027
text:
Description

Dział operacji Amazon stanowi podstawę obsługi klienta Amazon. Dzięki ponad 50 centrom logistycznym, setkom stacji dostaw i dziesiątkom tysięcy pracowników zespół ten wspólnie dba o sprawną dostawę produktów do klientów. W centrach logistycznych każdego roku kompletowane i pakowane są miliony produktów, a zespoły dostawcze dokładają wszelkich starań, aby zamówienia dotarły do klientów na czas. Bezpieczeństwo jest najwyższym priorytetem, a kultura operacyjna opiera się na pracy zespołowej, różnorodności i wspólnej etyce pracy, które zapewniają płynne funkcjonowanie firmy. Zespół szczyci się świadczeniem wysokiej jakości usług, z których Amazon słynie na całym świecie.

Uwaga: Warunkiem przyjęcia jest posiadanie prawa do pracy w kraju zatrudnienia przed datą rozpoczęcia pracy.

Należy pamiętać, że jest to stanowisko stacjonarne w pełnym wymiarze czasu pracy.

Stanowisko to jest dostępne w wielu lokalizacjach w Polsce. Oferujemy miesięczny bonus relokacyjny.

Rozważamy zatrudnianie kandydatów do pracy w następujących lokalizacjach:

Bielany Wrocławskie | Dobromierz | Gliwice | Gorzyczki | Łódź | Okmiany | Pabianice | Poznań | Sosnowiec | Szczecin | Świebodzin

Key job responsibilities

Główne obowiązki

Jako stażysta w dziale operacji Amazon będziesz mieć możliwość wykorzystania swoich umiejętności analitycznych w ważnych projektach, które poprawiają funkcjonalność i jakość usług centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania i stacji dostaw.

Kluczowe Obowiązki Stanowiska



-  Realizowanie projektów o wysokim priorytecie zgodnie z najwyższymi standardami oraz wykazywanie się umiejętnością osiągania wyników
-  Analizowanie danych w celu identyfikacji wyzwań operacyjnych i możliwości poprawy
-  Proponowanie i testowanie rozwiązań oraz współpraca z zespołem przy wdrażaniu tych najbardziej skutecznych
-  Rozwijanie umiejętności komunikacyjnych i pracy zespołowej poprzez współpracę z przełożonymi, interesariuszami i pracownikami pierwszej linii.
-  Przemieszczanie się po budynku w celu współpracy z różnymi zespołami. Obejmuje to aktywne zdobywanie wiedzy poprzez udział w takich działaniach, jak wstępne odprawy, spotkania dotyczące przepływu pracy oraz dyskusje z kierownictwem i współpracownikami.
-  Niezbędnym elementem tego stanowiska jest umiejętność poruszania się po miejscu pracy i przemieszczania się między różnymi obszarami.
-  Wykazywanie elastyczności w zakresie pracy w różnych harmonogramach i systemach zmianowych stosownie do potrzeb.
-  Potencjalna relokacja do wyznaczonego miejsca pracy.

A day in the life

Dzień z życia stażysty

Nasze staże to okazja do zdobycia wiedzy, która pozwoli Ci jako naszemu przyszłemu przełożonemu przekonać się, w jaki sposób zarządzamy zespołami pracowników i rozwijamy ich kompetencje. Poznasz dynamiczny i złożony świat naszych centrów logistycznych, centrów sortowania oraz stacji dostaw i zobaczysz, w jaki sposób nasi kierownicy motywują swoje zespoły do spełniania oczekiwań klientów.

Dzięki temu stażowi znajdziesz się w samym centrum naszych działań, co pozwoli Ci prześledzić drogę zamówienia klienta. Zyskasz realistyczny obraz pracy w pełnym wymiarze czasu, która czeka na Ciebie w naszej organizacji.

Dowiesz się, w jaki sposób nasi przełożeni tworzą bezpieczne i produktywne środowisko pracy, w pełni wykorzystując potencjał swoich zespołów dzięki skutecznym strategiom angażowania pracowników i zarządzania wynikami pracy. To szansa na rozwinięcie umiejętności, które pomogą Ci rozpocząć satysfakcjonującą karierę w Amazon.

About The Team

O zespole

Społeczność Stażystów



-  Jako stażysta Amazon będziesz częścią dynamicznej, wspierającej społeczności, która pomoże Ci się rozwijać. Będziesz współpracować ze stażystami z całego świata, nawiązywać kontakty i uczestniczyć w wydarzeniach towarzyskich, aby poszerzyć swoje horyzonty. Możesz również dołączyć do specjalistycznych grup zajmujących się takimi obszarami, jak zrównoważony rozwój, co pozwoli Ci rozwijać różnorodne zainteresowan

title: Founding Engineer
text:
About 0TO9

0TO9 is a bank for entrepreneurship, built by and for financial innovators. We provide infrastructure for entrepreneurs ready to start and scale the next generation of financial products and platforms. Founded in 2025, we're already 200+ co-workers across Europe, and growing fast. Our name reflects our mission: from zero to success, from idea to impact, from now to what's next.

The Venture

We're early and in stealth, so here's what we can say: it's a new banking business, separate from anything else in the group, aimed at a market we think is badly served today. The company is already led by a CEO. The customer, the product, and the wedge are what you'll help us find.

What we're not doing is a hiring cycle to backfill a team. You're early enough that the first architecture calls, the first engineering culture, and a good share of the product thinking are genuinely yours.

How We Build

This is the part we'd be lying about if we said everyone does it.

We build on .NET and SQL on the backend and TypeScript on the frontend (React and Vue). Prior experience in these helps, but it isn't the bar — what matters is that you want to build in them. Agentic tools make an unfamiliar stack cheap to learn; they don't make an unwilling one work. The fundamentals below are what we can't teach you in the first month:



- Engineering standards loaded as a skill, so agents apply them automatically.
- A git-backed knowledge base that agents read and extend.
- Agent workflows that take a change from branch to reviewed PR.
- An automated reviewer in CI that counts as an approving review on a pull request. In a team of one, that last one matters.

We're not looking for someone curious about whether this works. We're looking for someone who already builds this way - and will push it further than we have.

What You Will Actually Do



- Compress the distance between idea and working software: prototype, put it in front of real people, and let what you learn kill or grow it. Implementation is the fast part of this job; deciding what deserves to exist is the hard part.
- Sit close to the problem, not the backlog: you'll be in customer conversations and in the room where the business model gets argued about. We expect that to change your technical choices, not just inform them.
- Make fast, reversible decisions: simple, boring architecture that can be thrown away. We don't have scale yet, and pretending otherwise is the most expensive mistake available to us right now.
- Set how engineering works here: tooling, workflow, standards, guardrails — for whoever joins after you.

Technical Requirements

Agentic tools help you pick up anything unfamiliar fast - but these fundamentals should already be there:

Stack



- Backend: .NET and SQL.
- Frontend: TypeScript — React and Vue.

Cloud & Infrastructure



- AWS-native: ECS/Fargate, S3, least-privilege IAM.
- Container fluency: build, ship, and debug in production.
- Security by default: WAF, encryption at rest and in transit.
- EU data residency: aware of why region matters (eu-north-1).

Architecture



- Microservices & DDD: boundaries by domain, not layer.
- API/event-driven: no shared databases.
- Resilience patterns: retries, backoff, idempotency.
- Clean, SOLID code: safe for a human — or an agent — to extend.

Delivery & Quality



- CI/CD fluency: GitHub Actions or equivalent.
- Test-driven habits: 80%+ coverage, no exceptions.
- Reviewable PRs: small diffs, no self-merges.
- Supply-chain hygiene: dependency & SCA scanning before ship.

Observability & Security



- Structured logging & tracing: CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent.
- Zero hardcoded secrets: Secrets Manager or equivalent, always.
- Encryption everywhere: KMS at rest, TLS in transit.

Nice to Have



- .NET / TypeScript experience: you'll ramp faster. Coming from another ecosystem is fine if you're genuinely happy writing C#.
- Fintech / regulated-industry background: you'll ramp faster.
- Agenti

title: Full Stack Engineer
text:
Your impact

You'll join the Core team to rebuild our Core product with a fresh look and a new design system. You'll also maintain and improve our existing features along the way. This team is responsible for almost the entire user-facing interface, for which you will play an important role in its future development.

The Wrocław team works in a hybrid setup, i.e., we meet in the office twice a week (rented coworking space). On top of that, we try to have a small gathering every month in Wrocław. The schedule is adjusted to our needs.

Your Responsibilities



- Work with product, design, and other engineers to build new product features from start to finish: through ideation, research, implementation, and maintenance. For example, you might build an in-restaurant ordering feature.
- Leverage your full stack knowledge to help improve performance and reliability and polish existing features.
- Build and implement a roadmap to migrate the frontend from our old (existing component libraries) to our new stack (in-house design system).
- Establish best engineering practices for the Core Team.

What You'll Bring To The Table



- Great English language skills.
- Experience with building SaaS applications (ideally in a product-led company).
- Experience with modern JavaScript (and TypeScript), CSS, and Web APIs.
- Experience with component-based, declarative UIs (we use React).
- Experience with building APIs (both internal and external ones, e.g., for 3rd parties).
- Knowledge of rendering and design systems (as you’ll be building it up with us).
- Insights into accessibility in web apps.

Nice to have: 



- Knowledge of DevOps culture and tools like GitHub Actions or Kubernetes.
- Experience with Meteor.js (or similar real-time solution).
- Experience with GraphQL (we use Apollo Federation heavily).
- Experience with AWS and its ecosystem (Lambdas, going through CloudWatch logs).

Why You’ll love working at aleno



- Flexible working hours. Due to the customer support and the daily cycle of our core customer base, 10:00-15:00 CET is required. If you need to finish up earlier, it’s fine — that’s just the default. Other than that, there are no restrictions — just attend the meetings and stay in alignment with the team.
- Paid time off. All bank holidays are off. On top of that, there are 26 days of paid time off and 5 days of sick leave.
- Hardware. We can take care of a laptop and a headset for you (if needed).
- Traveling. Company retreats are expected but not mandatory (once for the whole company and once for the product team). All conferences, local events, and online events (meetups, conferences, etc.) are highly encouraged but not mandatory. Travel expenses can be covered in case of being a speaker and clearly mentioning aleno (for hiring, marketing, etc.)

Our hiring process

We aim to make our hiring process transparent, respectful of your time, and focused on finding the right mutual fit. After reviewing your application, we’ll invite selected candidates to a series of interviews. These typically include a conversation with the team, a technical or role-specific exercise, and time to get to know our culture and ways of working.

We do our best to keep the process efficient and streamlined — usually completing all steps within a couple of weeks.

About Us

aleno was founded in Zurich in 2014 by a team that had experienced first-hand how difficult it can be to run ones own restaurant. aleno is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

Our great team also operates from many other locations such as Berlin, Munich and Wroclaw.We have a dynamic corporate culture with a start-up mentality. We have passionate restaurateurs, sales and tech experts working hand in hand in flat hierarchies. Together, we are shaping the path to a new era of hospitality.

title: .NET Backend Engineer
text:
About 0TO9

0TO9 is a bank for entrepreneurship, built by and for financial innovators. We provide infrastructure for entrepreneurs ready to start and scale the next generation of financial products and platforms. Founded in Stockholm in 2025, we're already 200+ co-workers across Europe, with offices in Stockholm and Berlin.

Our name reflects our mission: from zero to success, from idea to impact, from now to what's next.

About The Role

At 0TO9 you'll build the systems behind the next wave of fintech ventures. It's a chance to solve complex problems at scale, on systems that are still young enough to shape.



- Build and maintain C#/.NET microservices on AWS ECS.
- Collaborate with product managers, architects, and engineers to deliver high-performance APIs
- Write clean, testable code following SOLID principles.
- Apply DDD and CQRS to create modular, scalable, and maintainable systems.
- Design event-driven communication using NATS.
- Ensure reliability through idempotency, retries, and self-healing services.
- Implement observability: logging, metrics, tracing, and performance monitoring.
- Work with both relational (MS SQL Server) and NoSQL (DynamoDB) databases.
- Contribute to secure design (auth, secrets, compliance).
- Improve CI/CD, containerized workflows, and engineering practices.
- Optionally, follow a feature into the frontend (TypeScript, React or Vue) when it needs to land end to end.

How we build

Agentic coding is our default, not an experiment. Across the group, we run a Claude-Code-native workspace:



- Engineering standards loaded as a skill, so agents apply them automatically.
- A git-backed knowledge base that agents read and extend.
- Agent workflows that take a change from branch to reviewed PR.
- An automated reviewer in CI that counts as an approving review on a pull request.

We're looking for someone who already works this way, and is comfortable making agents a normal part of how they build.

About You

We think you'll be a great fit if you:



- Have backend experience working with microservices and distributed systems, C# and .NET, and AWS.
- Take ownership, challenge unclear requirements, and prioritize reliability.
- Have applied DDD and CQRS in real-world systems.
- Understand event-driven architectures (ideally with NATS).
- Care about writing clean, maintainable, testable code.
- Already lean on LLMs and agentic tools daily, you see them as leverage, not a shortcut.

Technical Requirements

We build on .NET and SQL on the backend, with TypeScript, React and Vue, on the frontend. This role lives on the backend, and C# is a requirement. Frontend is a bonus, not a bar.

Cloud & Infrastructure



- AWS-native: ECS/Fargate, S3, least-privilege IAM.
- Container fluency: build, ship, and debug in production.
- Security by default: WAF, encryption at rest and in transit.
- EU data residency: aware of why region matters.

Architecture



- Microservices & DDD: boundaries by domain, not layer.
- API/event-driven: no shared databases.
- Resilience patterns: retries, backoff, idempotency.
- Clean, SOLID code: safe for a human or an agent to extend.

Delivery & Quality



- CI/CD fluency: GitHub Actions or equivalent.
- Test-driven habits: 80%+ coverage, no exceptions.
- Reviewable PRs: small diffs, no self-merges.
- Supply-chain hygiene: dependency & SCA scanning before ship.

Observability & Security



- Structured logging & tracing: CloudWatch, Datadog, or equivalent.
- Zero hardcoded secrets: Secrets Manager or equivalent, always.
- Encryption everywhere: KMS at rest, TLS in transit.

Nice to have



- Previous fintech or banking industry experience, you'll ramp faster.
- Hands-on experience with integration testing, contract testing, or end-to-end service testing.
- Knowledge of observability tools and testing strategies for microservices.
- Understanding of cloud security, governance, and compliance.

title: Otwarta Rekrutacja Arcadis (pracuj.pl)
text:
Arcadis zaprasza do współpracy osoby zaangażowane i z pozytywnym nastawieniem, które chcą wziąć udział w dużych, skomplikowanych projektach wielobranżowych z zakresu infrastruktury drogowej, kolejowej, budownictwa kubaturowego oraz hydrotechniki. W Arcadis koncentrujemy się na zatrudnieniu, angażowaniu i rozwoju osób, które podzielają naszą pasję i chęć poprawy jakości życia dla wszystkich ludzi na całym świecie. W ramach współpracy z ARCADIS będziesz miał okazję kształtować zarówno swoje najbliższe otoczenie, jak i cały świat.

Współpracując z nami, będziesz miał widoczny wpływ na rozwój naszej planety, co będzie możliwe między innymi poprzez współpracę z klientami, rozwijanie swoich umiejętności, walkę o równość lub działalność charytatywną – opcje są nieograniczone. Nasi pracownicy cenią różne perspektywy, dbają o zrównoważony rozwój naszej planety i mają odwagę kształtować nową, lepszą przyszłość.

Jedną z najważniejszych wartości ARCADIS jest rozwój naszych pracowników. Z pomocą fundacji Loovinklaan, inwestujemy w rozwój Arcadian, by w pełni wykorzystać ich potencjał.

Będziesz miał możliwość nawigować swoją karierą, uczestnicząc w międzynarodowych projektach branżowych i znajdując rozwiązania, które w przyszłości ułatwią ludziom życie.

title: Operations Human Resources Partner Intern (6 Months) - 2027
text:
Description

Power that runs the world | Discover careers in Operations

Operations roles at Amazon put you at the center of how things move from a click to a doorstep.

You’ll help design, improve, and run systems that connect people, products, and places, at scale. You’ll take ownership early, work closely with teams to solve real-world challenges, and see the direct results of your decisions as they reach customers every day.

Here, the impact of what you build isn’t abstract, it’s visible, immediate, and meaningful - keeping one of the world’s most complex operations moving forward.

This is where your journey takes shape through action, responsibility, and the opportunity to grow in many directions.

Key job responsibilities



-  Developing in-depth knowledge of HR functions within Amazon's fast-paced operations
-  Assisting with internal communication efforts to align teams across multiple countries, promoting collaboration and information-sharing
-  Helping develop training plans and materials to address the evolving development needs of various teams, supporting employee growth
-  Learning about HR functions across the broader Amazon organization and staying up-to-date on best practices
-  Providing support to Amazon employees on a range of daily queries related to attendance, engagement, compensation, and other HR matters
-  Assisting HR teams with day-to-day operational routines and administrative tasks
-  Participating in process reviews to identify opportunities for simplification and automation, driving efficiency improvements
-  Compiling comprehensive personnel statistics, reports, and performance evaluations to inform decision-making
-  Partnering closely with business leaders to align HR strategies and initiatives with organizational goals and priorities

A day in the life

Every day is a little different as an Operations Human Resources Partner Intern. This internship will immerse you in HR within a global organisation, with the opportunity to work on projects across different HR areas — from employee relations and training to compensation and workforce analytics. You might spend your morning analysing workforce data to identify trends and build recommendations for your team, then spend your afternoon supporting an employee relations case or collaborating with operations leaders on a training initiative.

Amazon's HR function is deeply embedded in the business, so no matter which project you are working on, part of your role will involve using data and analytical thinking to drive decisions. You'll apply your problem-solving and technical skills to real challenges, while developing important communication and professional soft skills through hands-on experience. With a dedicated mentor guiding your development throughout the programme, you'll gain insights into how HR partners with the business to drive growth and organisational excellence — providing a strong foundation for a career in human resources.

Note: You must have the right to work in the country of employment by the start date.

About The Team

Intern Community:

As an Amazon Intern, you'll be part of a dynamic, supportive community that empowers your growth and development. You'll collaborate with interns from around the world, networking and participating in social events to broaden your perspectives. You can also join specialized groups focused on areas like sustainability to explore your diverse interests.

Support

The internship program provides a robust support system, including weekly intern office hours, dedicated IT and HR support, and a program team committed to your success. This ensures you have the guidance and assistance needed to thrive.

Learning Sessions

Exclusive learning sessions will further enhance your skills, granting you access to Amazon's industry-leading learning platforms and the expertise of industry leaders. These structured development opportunities will prepare you for the next step in your career.

title: Technical Support Analyst with German
text:
Department: Customer Support

Location: Wroclaw

Description

Infor is seeking a Technical Support Analyst to join our Global Support team. In this role, you will support customers using Infor ERP solutions, helping them resolve complex technical issues and ensuring they get maximum value from their software investment.

This position is part of our COM System Support team, focusing on system-level troubleshooting rather than business process support. You will investigate issues related to databases, workflows, user access, printing, integrations, and application functionality while working closely with customers, Development, Product Management, and Consulting teams to identify and deliver effective solutions.

We are looking for someone who enjoys solving technical challenges, is naturally curious about how systems work, and can confidently interact with customers in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

- Provide high-quality technical support for Infor ERP applications, ensuring customer satisfaction and product usability.
- Investigate and resolve complex technical issues through root cause analysis and structured troubleshooting.
- Manage and prioritize customer cases through ServiceNow and other support tools.
- Conduct customer calls and remote troubleshooting sessions to diagnose and resolve issues.
- Analyze system behavior related to databases, workflows, printing, user access, and other technical components.
- Collaborate with Development, Product Management, and Consulting teams on escalated cases.
- Create and maintain case documentation, technical articles, and knowledge base content.

Basic Qualifications



- Professional-level verbal and written communication skills in German and English.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
- Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively within a global team.
- Experience supporting ERP, enterprise software, or SaaS applications.
- Knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
- Experience with ticketing and incident management systems such as ServiceNow.

Preferred Qualifications



- Familiarity with root cause analysis and technical troubleshooting methodologies.
- Knowledge of ITIL processes and best practices.
- Experience conducting remote customer troubleshooting sessions.

title: Serwisant/Serwisantka (Inżynier/ka Serwisu)
text:
Carrier Global Corporation, światowy lider w dziedzinie inteligentnych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, angażuje się w tworzenie innowacji, które zapewniają komfort, bezpieczeństwo i zrównoważony rozwój. Dzięki nowoczesnym rozwiązaniom w zakresie kontroli temperatury, jakości powietrza oraz transportu poprawiamy jakość życia, wspieramy kluczowe sektory gospodarki oraz zapewniamy bezpieczny transport żywności, leków ratujących życie i wielu innych produktów. Od momentu wynalezienia nowoczesnej klimatyzacji w 1902 roku działamy z jasno określoną misją: poprawiać jakość życia oraz świat, który wspólnie tworzymy. Naszą pozycję lidera zawdzięczamy światowej klasy, różnorodnemu i inkluzywnemu zespołowi, który stawia klienta w centrum wszystkich działań.

Więcej informacji można znaleźć na stronie corporate.carrier.com lub obserwując Carrier w mediach społecznościowych @Carrier.

Viessmann jest światowym liderem w dziedzinie zrównoważonych rozwiązań klimatycznych i energetycznych, zajmującym się tworzeniem przestrzeni życiowych dla przyszłych pokoleń. Obecnie, jako część grupy Carrier, firma Viessmann łączy innowacyjne technologie z silnym zaangażowaniem w ochronę środowiska, promując zrównoważony rozwój i komfort.

title: Intern Product Owner - Join our Product Squad!
text:
If you are a growth-oriented person who is passionate about delivering results, creating value, improving the team's efficiency, investigating problems, and finding solutions - join our Team! Our promise to the Team is that MasterBorn is the best place in the world to grow your career. 

We are working with well-established companies and sometimes startups in their early stages (MVPs), which makes the job full of diversity and exciting challenges while crafting cutting-edge solutions. Our clients and referrals are from the high-end American IT market.

Enjoy the flexibility of working within the Polish time zone while collaborating with clients from diverse industries such as Fintech, Sportstech, Medtech, and many others.

Join our Product Talent Pool and be first in line to take part in the recruitment process whenever a matching project appears.

Who we’re looking for:



- You’re curious about how digital products are built - from first idea to launch 
- Comfortable turning ideas into simple visuals on the spot (flows, diagrams, step-by-step breakdowns) to support client conversations 
- You’re proactive, communicative, and not afraid to ask questions 
- You want to learn how to work with developers, designers, and clients 
- You have basic knowledge of tools like Notion, FigJam, or Jira 
- You’re fluent in Polish and English (min. C1 for both - it’s a must) 
- You have an active student status 


Bonus points if you:



- Were involved in student organizations, startups, or hackathons 
- Have an interest in AI, no-code, or automation tools 
- Have heard of (or practiced) Scrum, Agile, or Lean Startup 
- Already played the role of Product Owner or Project Lead in any context 


What you’ll learn - here's what to expect:



- You’ll work with experienced mentors on real, cross-functional projects 
- You’ll support Product Owners in managing the backlog, defining tasks, and keeping delivery on track 
- You’ll join client calls and internal stand-ups - and might even facilitate your own, with support 
- You’ll learn how to collaborate with designers and developers and how to write clear, structured documentation 
- You’ll see how we plan, estimate, prioritize, and iterate in real teams 
- You’ll get feedback from your mentor, your project teams, and the whole Delivery team 
- You might also support marketing or internal initiatives (if you’re up for it!) 


Recruitment Process:



- CV Review
- Phone call with our Recruiter (15min)
- Soft-skills interview with our Recruiter (30min)
- Technical interview with our Product Owner (1h) 
- Interview with your Department Head (45min)
- Decision and feedback 🥳


Perks & Benefits:



- Paid 3-month internship with real responsibilities
- Option to extend the cooperation
- Path toward a Junior Product Owner role
- Regular feedback, mentoring, and shadowing opportunities
- Access to our internal Delivery Talks, Design Talks, and Tech Talks
- A friendly, feedback-driven culture where you can ask anything and grow fast


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Salary: PLN 4.300 brutto (UZL)

title: Data Management Team Member with German | FS Consulting
text:

Key Responsibilities

Imagine being at the center of global trade flows. Step into a role where no two days are the same. Here, you’ll combine analytical thinking, process excellence, and teamwork to manage the full lifecycle of trades from confirmation to settlement to collateral. Your ability to connect details to the bigger picture will shape the quality and reliability of our global investment operations.

You’ll be responsible for:



-  Managing both manual and electronic trade confirmations with a focus on accuracy and timeliness

You’ll be part of the Asset Management Derivatives Operations team in Wroclaw, Poland, supporting global confirmation, settlement, collateral, and reconciliation processes for derivative instruments and securities trading activity.

You’ll join a culture that values collaboration, curiosity, and excellence, where every voice counts and every improvement makes a difference.

You’re someone who sees beyond numbers and you understand how precision drives trust and how processes power performance.

title: Internship - Source to Pay (Procurement department)
text:
The Position

Joining our company, you will gather an overview of the Source to Pay Organization with a particular focus on the tasks and responsibilities of the Procurement Process. You will be qualified to independently contribute to the daily run-mode activities. As an intern, you will be able to support the Procurement team on daily tasks by learning how to use different tools and systems. 



The start time of our 6 months long paid internship program as well as the working hours can be flexibly adjusted to your availability. We are meeting on-site in our office in Wrocław at least 3 days a week. 
Tasks & responsibilities 

As an Intern in the Procurement Department, you will be responsible for: 





- Assisting in preparing purchase orders and ensuring timely approvals. 

- Supporting the maintenance of accurate procurement records and documentation. 

- Participating in team and country meetings. 

- Participating in trainings (according to the training schedule) and workshops. 

- Handling multiple data entries in the system. 

- Supporting projects, research activities, and team engagement initiatives. 

- Preparing and analyzing reports. 

- Identifying and supporting the implementation of process improvements. 

- Responding to queries from internal employees concerning the Procurement process. 

- Supporting additional tasks related to Plant Maintenance (e.g., Purchase Info Records creation and updates). 


About our future Intern

You should speak English on min. B1 level and have the willingness to learn new skills and to take over the responsibility for the assigned tasks.

 
Additionally, we are looking for: 




- Students or graduates interested in the field of finance/administration

- Proactivity, good organization of the own work and the ability to prioritize

- Attention to detail and problem-solving skills with high level of reliability and confidentiality

- Empathy, team spirit and service-oriented mindset

- Knowledge of MS Office (Word and Excel)

- Existing experience in a professional business environment, e.g. previous internships or relevant student work is a plus

- Knowledge of German would be an advantage

 
Our Company

 Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,300 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com. 

Why Boehringer Ingelheim?

 
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.
Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.
Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations. 

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Nasze doświadczenie obejmuje działalność w sektorach: budowlanym, energetycznym, przemysłowym, energii odnawialnej, drogowym, kolejowym (metro i tramwaje) oraz nieruchomości. - Prawo jazdy kat. B.

title: Elektromechanik pojazdów samochodowych (K/M)

text:
Description

We are seeking a Mid-level Software Engineer to join our Platform Infrastructure Team. The team is responsible for low-level operating systems, virtualization hypervisors, and custom Linux kernel builds powering our global cloud fleet. You will take ownership of kernel rebasing, QEMU tuning, and security hardware integration to bring up our new bare-metal ARM compute nodes.

Requirements

Education & experience: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, plus heavy experience in kernel and low-level systems engineering.

Kernel Expertise: Deep engineering background working with the Linux kernel (v6.x) and ARM64 architecture internals.

System Programming: Mastery of C, assembly, and low-level OS integrations.

Virtualization & Security: Deep experience with KVM and QEMU (specifically ARM-on-ARM nested virtualization), plus TPM 2.0 / vTPM integration.

Debugging & Tools: Hands-on experience with cross-compilation toolchains, low-level debuggers (GDB, JTAG, trace tools), and bare-metal lab host bring-up.

Job responsibilities

Configure, patch, and build the Linux kernel and QEMU for optimal security and performance on ARM hardware.

Migrate and rebase existing x86 custom kernel patches to support the new ARM Debian build.

Implement and test TPM 2.0 measured boot protocols and vTPM virtualization integrations.

Set up cross-compilation build pipelines (MBS / Jenkins) for building QEMU, Linux, and kernel modules.

Debug complex hardware-software integration issues directly on physical ARM bare-metal lab machines.

Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment.

Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company.

About GlobalLogic

GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.
